summary: The closed lane registry becomes research, implement, design, review, verify. The design lane implements visual UI and UX changes for one approved bounded task under implement-matching budgets, and its completions must discharge a new visual_artifacts obligation extended into the CD-0056 closed vocabulary across both schema enums, the Go slice, and the worker-complete CLI spec. The manifest digest moves, the four pre-existing lane digests do not, and model resolution stays with the host under CD-0058.
title: The registry gains a design worker lane
